audit.whatIsWrong: Ziggs wins 35.71% of these games, yet the chart gives him four stages outright and calls the last three even, and the page is labelled 'Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10' with the green tone while diff already says HARD.
audit.why: The mirror audit flipped three stages to Dr. Mundo as one atomic group and moved diff to HARD on its side. A health-stacking tank with two healing abilities does not go even against poke that cannot execute him — after his first HP item the lane is his. Matching the mirror keeps the pages consistent and makes the badge agree with the win rate.
audit.corrected: win[4..6] and phases[4..6].side to Dr. Mundo with ratings 4/3/2, diffRating 7/10, carryRating 8/10, red tone, and the difficulty sentence rewritten in both places.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item spike names Luden's/Liandry's against the page's Blackfire Torch build, and the level 6 and first-item stages both claim Ziggs wins them.
audit.why: Maximum Dosage is a flat 120s that instantly heals a percentage of MISSING health and then regenerates a portion of his maximum health over a long duration — the lower he is, the more it returns, so chip poke funds it. Heart Zapper (17s at rank 1) heals a percentage of the damage he stored while it ran. Both are why the level 6 and first-item stages belong to him unless Grievous Wounds is already bought.
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text switched to Blackfire Torch and given the anti-heal timing; whys[4], whys[5], phases[4].why, phases[5].why and phases[6].why rewritten to argue the new sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states that successive mine detonations on the same target deal reduced damage, and Infected Bonesaw's range is never given.
audit.why: Hexplosive Minefield's repeat-hit falloff is the single most important mechanic against a health stacker: re-laying mines on a target you have already hit pays less each time, so one clean field plus Bouncing Bomb beats spamming E at him. Infected Bonesaw is 975 range on a flat 4s and deals current-health damage — it out-ranges your 850 Q and is what walks you down, so the slow, not the burst, is the thing to dodge.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d now carries the diminishing-mine rule; wants.you[2] and spikes[2].text carry the 975 range.
